title: Elevator descent at the facility
summary: Bob Lazar tells of Elevator descent at the facility, about 1980s at S4, Nevada, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: In that building we went into an elevator. We took an elevator down, which that was the first odd thing is that it felt like we went down significantly further than like you would think you would.

plain: Randy Anderson, speaking on podcast host Jesse Michels's show, says that sometime in the 1980s he was taken into a building at a secret site in Nevada called S4. He says they went down in an elevator, and the first odd thing was that it felt like they went much deeper underground than you would expect. He tells it as a sign that the facility hid far more below ground than it showed above.
